339-677-4460-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

323-792-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-792-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Lavabrink Floodgates which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1090-2350-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1322-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2908-4986-5231--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-4986-5231--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1170-1328-2105-4460.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-4460.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1661-4668-5078.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.

2762-4659-5491.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Map and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Map, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2179-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Mishra's Warform's ability.
Resolve both Mishra's Warform abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn, and repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

3490-4476-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4476-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3901-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3901-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
3901-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing 100 damage to any target that isn't a Dragon

Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.

372-2705-5276.description:
Cast Suspension Field by paying {1}{W}.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Leonin Relic-Warder to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Suspension Field.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Suspension Field to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

262-2335-2744.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-2335-2744.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Barrenton Medic has a power of two or greater, it will also get infinite +1/+1 counters.

"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.

Resolve the Tobias trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Tobias from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

150-215-2404-4693.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Titania's second ability triggers, creating a 5/3 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain three life.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Titania by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Titania enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, putting Gaea's Cradle onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

188-2178-3500.notablePrerequisites:
All permanent attached to the same creature.

Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent's creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat.

1987-2427-3277-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.

When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
